test_cases.title: SET_TIMING_PROFILE broadcast to R1 chain (L1/L3/L5) - ACK

checks.description: lx_fsm_on_set_timing_profile() ACKs L1's offset (0ms, well under LX_CYCLE_LENGTH_MS)
ACK for L3 (offset 21000ms, R1_CHAIN)
ACK for L5 (offset 45000ms, R1_CHAIN)

test_cases.title: SET_TIMING_PROFILE while Lx is FAULT_SAFE - NACK FAULT_ACTIVE
test_cases.skip_reason: Requires L1 in SUPERVISORY_FAULT_SAFE. lx_sensor.c (confirmed by reading the current source) has no demo fault-injection key (unlike rlx_sensor.c's x/f) - the only real way to trip PA-10 is kill -STOP/-CONT on lx_main's PID for >=2s (see docs/test-plan/02-state-machine-transition.md TC-SC03A-6), which is an OS signal, not a stdin keystroke the steps[].send schema can express.

test_cases.title: offset_ms at upper boundary (>= LX_CYCLE_LENGTH_MS) - NACK STALE_OR_UNSAFE_PROFILE
test_cases.skip_reason: c_operator.c's 't' command only ever broadcasts the fixed R1_CHAIN/R2_CHAIN offsets (0/19000/21000/42000/45000ms) - none >= LX_CYCLE_LENGTH_MS (90000). Reaching lx_fsm_on_set_timing_profile()'s offset_ms=90000 boundary requires the not-yet-built test_client to hand-craft the payload directly to L1.

test_cases.title: offset_ms just under upper boundary (LX_CYCLE_LENGTH_MS - 1) - ACK
test_cases.skip_reason: Same reasoning as TC-MSG-3 - c_operator.c cannot submit an arbitrary offset_ms=89999; only the not-yet-built test_client can send a hand-crafted SET_TIMING_PROFILE payload directly to L1.

test_cases.title: SET_MODE with mode == current mode - ACK (no-op)

checks.description: L1 cold-starts at MODE_PEAK_FIXED(0); requesting the same mode is a no-op ACK, not ACK_PENDING

test_cases.title: SET_MODE to a different mode - ACK_PENDING

checks.description: L1 is MODE_PEAK_FIXED; requesting OFF_PEAK_SENSOR defers to the next ALL_RED boundary per SC-01A, replying ACK_PENDING immediately

test_cases.title: Cancel a pending mode-change by re-requesting the current mode before the boundary

checks.description: first request (OFF_PEAK_SENSOR) is deferred

second request re-asks for PEAK_FIXED, which now equals fsm->mode again (mode_change_pending never applied yet, since PHASE_ARTERIAL_GREEN's 48s duration keeps this well before the next ALL_RED boundary) - lx_fsm_on_set_mode() treats it as a no-op ACK, clearing mode_change_pending

test_cases.title: SET_MODE while Lx is FAULT_SAFE - NACK FAULT_ACTIVE
test_cases.skip_reason: Same fault-injection blocker as TC-MSG-2 - lx_sensor.c has no demo key to force SUPERVISORY_FAULT_SAFE, and forcing the real PA-10 watchdog requires kill -STOP/-CONT on lx_main's PID, outside the stdin-only steps[].send model.

test_cases.title: SET_MODE with mode outside 0/1 - NACK OUT_OF_RANGE (UC-07 step 3)
test_cases.skip_reason: c_operator.c's handle_set_mode() rejects any mode != 0/1 client-side ('not a valid mode ... command aborted') before ever sending it - lx_fsm_on_set_mode()'s NACK_REASON_OUT_OF_RANGE branch is unreachable from the console. Requires the not-yet-built test_client to send a raw mode=2 payload directly to L1.

test_cases.title: REQUEST_OVERRIDE valid, no conflict - ACK

checks.description: L1 at NORMAL_OPERATION with no fault/preemption/ped-clearance - lx_fsm_on_request_override() ACKs immediately (OVR_ACTIVE)

test_cases.title: REQUEST_OVERRIDE while pedestrian clearance is running - ACK_PENDING (SC-03B)

checks.description: L1 is mid WALK/FLASHING_DONT_WALK (ped side 0 pressed at t=0, 10s total per LX_WALK_MS+LX_FLASHING_DONT_WALK_MS) when the override for the same-side-compatible arterial movement arrives - lx_fsm_on_request_override() queues OVR_PENDING_CLEARANCE and replies ACK_PENDING, never NACK_REASON_PEDESTRIAN_ACTIVE (which is dead code - see doc appendix)

test_cases.title: REQUEST_OVERRIDE while another override is already active - NACK OUT_OF_RANGE

checks.description: first override (arterial, 30s) is accepted and still active
lx_fsm_on_request_override() rejects a second REQUEST_OVERRIDE while SUPERVISORY_CENTRAL_OVERRIDE is already active - use RENEW_OVERRIDE instead (no dedicated reason code exists)

test_cases.title: REQUEST_OVERRIDE duration_ms=0 - rejected by Central pre-check (never forwarded)

checks.pattern: Operator: REQUEST_OVERRIDE\(target=1, movement=0, duration_ms=0\) rejected by Central pre-check, reason=INVALID_DURATION - not forwarded to the controller
checks.description: c_mode_eng_validate_override_request() rejects duration_ms==0 at Central, before ipc_client_post() is ever called - no C1: REQUEST_OVERRIDE to 1 -> ... line should ever appear for this request

test_cases.title: REQUEST_OVERRIDE duration_ms=300001 - rejected by Central pre-check (never forwarded)

checks.pattern: Operator: REQUEST_OVERRIDE\(target=1, movement=0, duration_ms=300001\) rejected by Central pre-check, reason=INVALID_DURATION - not forwarded to the controller
checks.description: same Central pre-check as TC-MSG-12, upper bound

test_cases.title: REQUEST_OVERRIDE duration_ms=0 sent straight to Lx, bypassing Central - real Lx-side NACK INVALID_DURATION
test_cases.skip_reason: c_operator.c's Central-side pre-check (c_mode_eng_validate_override_request()) rejects duration_ms==0 before ever forwarding it, so lx_fsm_on_request_override()'s own real NACK_REASON_INVALID_DURATION branch can never be reached from the console. Requires the not-yet-built test_client to send directly to L1, bypassing Central entirely.

test_cases.title: REQUEST_OVERRIDE while Lx is under RAILWAY_PREEMPTION - NACK RAILWAY_CONFLICT

checks.description: RL1 OPEN->WARNING (rlx_fsm_simulate_train_approaching) broadcasts CROSSING_STATUS(WARNING) to L1 (adjacent per ADJACENCY[]) on its next 1s tick, putting L1 into SUPERVISORY_RAILWAY_PREEMPTION before the override request arrives

test_cases.title: REQUEST_OVERRIDE while Lx is FAULT_SAFE - NACK FAULT_ACTIVE
test_cases.skip_reason: Same fault-injection blocker as TC-MSG-2/8 - no lx_sensor.c demo key exists to force SUPERVISORY_FAULT_SAFE without a real >=2s watchdog trip via kill -STOP/-CONT, which is outside the stdin-only steps[].send model.

test_cases.title: REQUEST_OVERRIDE duration_ms=1 - ACK (lower valid boundary, PA-11)

checks.description: duration_ms=1 is inside (0, 300000] - ACK; override then self-terminates on the very next 100ms phase-timer tick

test_cases.title: REQUEST_OVERRIDE duration_ms=300000 - ACK (upper valid boundary, PA-11)

checks.description: duration_ms=300000 == LX_OVERRIDE_DURATION_CAP_MS - still accepted (300001 is rejected, see TC-MSG-13)

test_cases.title: RENEW_OVERRIDE valid on an ACTIVE override - ACK

checks.description: establishes the OVR_ACTIVE override this renewal targets
override is SUPERVISORY_CENTRAL_OVERRIDE/OVR_ACTIVE - lx_fsm_on_renew_override() ACKs and restarts the countdown at 60000ms

test_cases.title: RENEW_OVERRIDE with no override in flight - NACK UNKNOWN_TARGET

checks.description: L1 has never had an override (BR-7: c_operator.c warns but still forwards); lx_fsm_on_renew_override() NACKs since override_substate != OVR_ACTIVE

test_cases.title: RENEW_OVERRIDE while override is OVR_PENDING_CLEARANCE (not yet active) - NACK UNKNOWN_TARGET

checks.description: override is queued behind the pedestrian clearance started at t=0 (10s WALK+FDW window)

renew is sent while still OVR_PENDING_CLEARANCE (well before the 10s ped clearance completes) - lx_fsm_on_renew_override() requires override_substate == OVR_ACTIVE exactly, so PENDING_CLEARANCE also NACKs

test_cases.title: RENEW_OVERRIDE extend_duration_ms=300001 - NACK INVALID_DURATION

checks.description: override active
extend_duration_ms=300001 exceeds LX_OVERRIDE_DURATION_CAP_MS - existing expiry is retained unchanged

test_cases.title: RENEW_OVERRIDE extend_duration_ms=0 - ACK, resets to the ORIGINAL duration

checks.description: override active with duration_ms=20000

sent ~5s later (remaining_ms has drifted down from 20000); extend_duration_ms=0 means 'reset to override_duration_ms' (20000), not 'extend by 0' or 'set remaining to 0' - lx_fsm_on_renew_override()'s special-case semantics

test_cases.title: RENEW_OVERRIDE extend_duration_ms=300000 - ACK (upper valid boundary)

checks.description: override active
extend_duration_ms=300000 == LX_OVERRIDE_DURATION_CAP_MS - accepted

test_cases.title: RENEW_OVERRIDE extend_duration_ms=1 - ACK (explicit 1ms renewal, not the 0=keep-original case)

checks.description: override active
extend_duration_ms=1 is a real 1ms renewal (distinct from TC-MSG-23's 0='keep original'); override_duration_ms/remaining_ms become 1, terminating on the next tick

test_cases.title: CANCEL_OVERRIDE on an ACTIVE override - ACK

checks.description: override active, long duration to leave room for the cancel
lx_fsm_on_cancel_override() ACKs and runs safe clearance back to NORMAL_OPERATION

test_cases.title: CANCEL_OVERRIDE on an OVR_PENDING_CLEARANCE override (not yet active) - ACK

checks.description: override queued behind ped clearance (10s window from t=0)
unlike RENEW_OVERRIDE (TC-MSG-21), lx_fsm_on_cancel_override() accepts both OVR_ACTIVE and OVR_PENDING_CLEARANCE - cancel fully discards the queued override before it ever activates

test_cases.title: CANCEL_OVERRIDE with no override in flight - NACK UNKNOWN_TARGET

checks.description: L1 is NORMAL_OPERATION, override_substate == OVR_NONE

test_cases.title: Two near-simultaneous CANCEL_OVERRIDE to the same Lx (race/idempotency)
test_cases.skip_reason: Requires two independent test_client processes sending MSG_CANCEL_OVERRIDE to L1 within milliseconds of each other to race lx_fsm_t's own mutex. c_operator.c reads stdin on a single thread (c_operator_reader_thread) - two 'c' keypresses from one process can never be truly concurrent - and the not-yet-built test_client tool doesn't exist to run as two independent racing processes.

test_cases.title: REQUEST_FAULT_CLEAR when RLx is not in FAULT - NACK UNKNOWN_TARGET

checks.description: RL1 (numeric CTRL_RL1=7) cold-starts RLX_OPEN, not RLX_FAULT - rlx_fsm_on_fault_clear() NACKs

test_cases.title: REQUEST_FAULT_CLEAR while RLx is FAULT but gate not confirmed open - NACK FAULT_ACTIVE

checks.description: x arms the next gate motion to fail confirmation (RC-06 demo); 0 triggers TRAIN_APPROACHING dir0 -> WARNING -> (5s) CLOSING -> (15s deadline) enter_fault(FAULT_GATE_CONFIRM_MISSING)
enter_fault() re-issued rlx_gate_command_close() (not armed to fail this time), so 3s later gates confirm CLOSED, not OPEN - rlx_gate_poll_open()==0 keeps the NACK

test_cases.title: REQUEST_FAULT_CLEAR -> ACK once the gate is confirmed open (demo repair path)

checks.pattern: Gate mechanism simulated as physically repaired - now confirmed OPEN
checks.description: the current rlx_sensor.c ('r' key -> rlx_gate_force_confirmed_open()) already implements the fix the test-plan .md proposed as a future patch - it forces g_confirmed_open=1 synchronously while state is still RLX_FAULT, which the .md (written before this key existed) said was otherwise unreachable
rlx_fsm_on_fault_clear() re-checks rlx_gate_poll_open() live and now sees 1 - ACK, RL1 returns to RLX_OPEN

test_cases.title: REQUEST_FAULT_CLEAR to an Lx that is FAULT_SAFE - ACK
test_cases.skip_reason: Requires L1 already in SUPERVISORY_FAULT_SAFE - same blocker as TC-MSG-2/8/16: lx_sensor.c has no demo fault key, and the documented working method (docs/test-plan/02-state-machine-transition.md TC-SC03A-6) is kill -STOP/-CONT on lx_main's PID for >=2s, an OS signal outside the stdin-only steps[].send automation model.

test_cases.title: REQUEST_FAULT_CLEAR to a FAULT_SAFE Lx while the adjacent crossing is still closed - resumes RAILWAY_PREEMPTION, not NORMAL_OPERATION
test_cases.skip_reason: Same FAULT_SAFE fault-injection blocker as TC-MSG-33, plus requires orchestrating a real watchdog trip while RAILWAY_PREEMPTION is already active - both preconditions need kill -STOP/-CONT on lx_main's PID, outside the stdin-only steps[].send automation model.

test_cases.title: MSG_STATUS valid to C1 - ACK
test_cases.skip_reason: Confirmed by grepping lx_comm.c/rlx_comm.c: no sender in the current codebase ever transmits MSG_STATUS (only HEARTBEAT/FAULT_REPORT/CROSSING_STATUS are sent). Producing this verb on the wire requires the not-yet-built test_client.

test_cases.title: MSG_STATUS with role mismatched to sender_id - still ACK (robustness)
test_cases.skip_reason: Same as TC-MSG-34 (no real sender for MSG_STATUS exists) plus requires deliberately mismatching payload.status.role vs sender_id, which only a hand-crafted test_client payload can do.

test_cases.title: MSG_FAULT_REPORT when RLx actually enters FAULT - ACK

checks.pattern: FAULT_REPORT from 7: fault_code=0x00000001 severity=1 detail="RLx fault - see fault_code bitmask"
checks.description: RLx auto-sends MSG_FAULT_REPORT the instant enter_fault() runs (rlx_fsm_take_fault_report_pending(), same tick as the CLOSING deadline miss ~20s in); c_main.c's on_request() always ACKs and prints this line directly (no NACK branch exists for this verb)

test_cases.title: MSG_FAULT_REPORT with a non-null-terminated detail[64] - memory-safety robustness check
test_cases.skip_reason: rlx_comm_send_fault_report() always strncpy()s and force-terminates the last byte with '\0' - no real code path can produce a non-terminated detail string. Requires the not-yet-built test_client to hand-craft a malformed payload.

test_cases.title: CROSSING_STATUS(WARNING) to adjacent Lx - ACK, Lx enters RAILWAY_PREEMPTION

checks.description: c_hmi_render()'s network table (1Hz) shows L1's SUPERVISORY column = 1 (SUPERVISORY_RAILWAY_PREEMPTION) once L1's next HEARTBEAT reports it, after RL1 OPEN->WARNING broadcasts CROSSING_STATUS to adjacent L1/L2 (ADJACENCY[]) and C1 - lx_fsm_on_crossing_status() always ACKs (RC-02: Lx never rejects)

test_cases.title: CROSSING_STATUS to C1 - ACK, C1 updates last_reported_crossing_state

checks.description: c_server_record_crossing_status() sets last_reported_crossing_state=CROSSING_WARNING(1) for RL1's row, and resets missed_heartbeat_ticks/marked_unavailable; c_main.c's on_request() case MSG_CROSSING_STATUS always ACKs

test_cases.title: No duplicate CROSSING_STATUS broadcast when the wire-visible state does not change (dedup)
test_cases.skip_reason: Verifying dedup requires proving a SECOND CROSSING_STATUS broadcast does NOT happen when RL1's internal state changes WARNING->CLOSING (both map to the same wire value CROSSING_WARNING, per map_to_crossing_state()) - runner.py's checks[] can only assert a pattern's presence within a window, never its absence over a window. This is exactly the class of check the tool's README flags as needing a human/other-tool judgment a regex can't replace.

test_cases.title: CROSSING_STATUS with state outside the valid enum range - still ACK, treated as not-OPEN (robustness)
test_cases.skip_reason: rlx_comm.c never produces a state value outside crossing_state_t's 0-3 range - reaching this requires the not-yet-built test_client to hand-craft payload.crossing_status.state=999 directly to L1.

test_cases.title: HEARTBEAT 1Hz from Lx - continuous ACK, L1 stays AVAILABLE

checks.description: setup_wait_ms=4000 lets PA-07's 3-tick (3s) missed-heartbeat threshold pass before the check clock (t0) starts; L1's HEARTBEAT (1Hz) keeps resetting missed_heartbeat_ticks/marked_unavailable via c_server_record_status(), so the check would FAIL (see UNAVAILABLE in TC-MSG-43) if HEARTBEAT handling were broken - it only passes because ACK processing keeps working past the 3s mark

test_cases.title: 3 consecutive missed heartbeats - Lx marked UNAVAILABLE (PA-07)

checks.pattern: Controller 1 marked UNAVAILABLE - missed 3 consecutive heartbeats
checks.description: Equivalent automation of 'kill lx_main 1 mid-run': L1 is simply never started, so c_mode_eng.controllers[0] (CTRL_L1=1) never receives a proof-of-life - c_watchdog_mon_tick()'s 1Hz counter reaches exactly 3 missed ticks and edge-triggers marked_unavailable=1/this log line, identical counting logic to a genuinely-killed process (missed_heartbeat_ticks starts at 0 either way)

test_cases.title: HEARTBEAT from RLx - role=ROLE_RAILWAY, mode/signal_phase=0 not misinterpreted

checks.description: rlx_fsm_fill_status() only fills role/crossing_state/faults for ROLE_RAILWAY - mode stays 0 and c_hmi_render() renders RL1's PHASE column as '-' (role != ROLE_INTERSECTION), confirming mode=0/signal_phase=0 are not misread as meaningful MODE_PEAK_FIXED/PHASE_ARTERIAL_GREEN values; crossing_state=0 (CROSSING_OPEN, RL1's cold-start state) appears in its own column

test_cases.title: HEARTBEAT with role outside the valid enum range - still ACK (negative/robustness)
test_cases.skip_reason: No path in lx_comm.c/rlx_comm.c ever produces a role outside {ROLE_CENTRAL, ROLE_INTERSECTION, ROLE_RAILWAY} - reaching payload.heartbeat.summary.role=99 requires the not-yet-built test_client to hand-craft the payload directly to C1.
